card.name: The end of interleukin names
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, right before a hyphen and number such as -1, -2 or -6. It also fires weakly on a few odd fragments in other scripts or capitalized words.

modes.label: Interleukin ending
modes.description: The "in" that completes interleukin, just before a hyphen and a number.
modes.example: concurrent use of anakinra (an interleuk<<in>>-1 antagonist) and another TNF

modes.label: Stray fragments
modes.description: Rare partway-through-word pieces in capitalized text or non-Latin script.

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens and the output; it seems to mark a word that is already complete.
